persona: Polite; English is her second language and she writes short sentences. Has one photo and the quote; has made two other claims this year and says so if asked.
initial_message: Hello, I have small accident on Wednesday 26 August, around 5.40 in the evening. I drive down the ramp in the parking building in the city and my car is touching the wall on left side. Now the two doors on left have long scratch and dent, and the mirror is broken. Nobody is hurt and the car is still can drive. What I must do for make a claim?

facts.incident.description: I was driving down the curved ramp between two levels of the parking building. I kept too far to the left and the left side of the car rubbed along the concrete wall.
facts.incident.location: Parking building on Tussock Test Way, Christchurch Central City, Christchurch
facts.incident.cause: Drove too close to the wall on a curved parking building ramp
facts.loss.description: Both left doors scraped, a dent in the left front door, left door mirror housing cracked
facts.policyholder.name: Hannah Kowhaiford
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Long horizontal scrapes along the lower half of both left doors, a shallow dent in the front door, and the left door mirror housing cracked and hanging down. The mirror glass is broken.
facts.driver.name: Hannah Kowhaiford
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the left side of the car. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Cedar Holt Auto Refinish dated 10 September 2026, total $1,995.25 including GST. Available now.
facts.parking_building.damage: The wall has only some red paint on it. The parking staff said it is fine.
facts.if_asked_about_previous_claims: Yes. In January my laptop fall from the table and break, I claim for this. In June somebody scratch my car in the car park at night, I claim also.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo, close-up of the left side of a red hatchback parked in a dim concrete parking building. Long horizontal scrapes with grey concrete marks run along the lower half of both left doors, with a shallow dent in the front door, and the left door mirror housing is cracked and hanging down. Fluorescent lighting, a painted concrete pillar in the background. The frame shows only the two doors and the mirror. No text, no logos, no people.

triage.rationale: Single vehicle against a parking building wall, nobody hurt, car drivable, a photo and a complete quote at NZD 1,995.25 including GST. Two other submitted claims in the past year give one weak indicator, so staff get a hint; it does not change the fraud signal. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: Two other submitted claims in the past year: contents (incident 15 January 2026, submitted 16 January 2026) and motor (incident 28 June 2026, submitted 30 June 2026)

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2023-06-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

possible_duplicate.basis: The earlier motor claim is from 28 June 2026, not within 3 days of 26 August 2026; the other is contents
